name: AI UI Style Vault Immersive Template Library
principle: Select an immersive architecture only when it materially improves the verified business story or interaction goal; otherwise use the normal domain-pack build.

templates.label: Fluid Canvas Brand Hero
templates.summary: Full-viewport pointer/touch-responsive fluid field behind semantic brand content.
templates.mobile: Reduce simulation/dye resolution, disable expensive bloom/sunrays first, preserve touch without blocking scroll outside the hero.
templates.reducedMotion: Replace continuous simulation with a static approved gradient or still capture.
templates.fallback: Semantic hero remains fully usable without WebGL.
avoid: professional services without an expressive brand reason
using fluid motion as fake data visualization

templates.label: Motion-Rich Portfolio
templates.summary: Responsive portfolio/agency architecture using staggered reveals, restrained particles, animated gradients and tactile navigation without requiring WebGL.
templates.mobile: Preserve hierarchy and navigation; reduce floating ornaments and long-running decorative animation.
templates.reducedMotion: Static gradients and immediate content reveal with identical copy and navigation.
templates.fallback: Normal semantic portfolio with no animation.
avoid: turning every section into floating particles
random movement that competes with project content

templates.label: Continuous Scroll Narrative
templates.summary: Smooth-scroll chapter storytelling with a persistent visual stage, section transitions and optional shader/canvas interaction.
templates.mobile: Shorter pinned intervals or no pinning; maintain normal document flow and readable chapter order.
templates.reducedMotion: Disable scrub/pinned transformations and render chapters as normal stacked sections.
templates.fallback: All story copy and actions remain semantic DOM in reading order.
avoid: long pinned sections with no information gain

templates.label: Tactile 3D Object Library
templates.summary: Browse, select, inspect, manipulate and return through a deterministic 3D object state machine.
templates.mobile: Guided touch inspection, bounded camera, fewer objects and simpler materials; keep a DOM list/index.
templates.reducedMotion: Instant/shortened state changes and static object views; preserve browse/select actions.
templates.fallback: Normal catalog/gallery with direct links and approved still imagery.
avoid: copying Complete Shelf code/artwork without a reuse licence
3D when users only need a normal product grid

templates.label: Procedural Living World
templates.summary: A seeded procedural environment that reacts subtly to pointer/touch while editorial content stays semantic.
templates.mobile: Substantially reduce instance counts and pointer effects; prefer authored single-column layout.
templates.reducedMotion: Freeze environmental motion, remove particle bursts, preserve static procedural composition or approved media.
templates.fallback: Editorial content remains readable even when the procedural scene cannot start.
avoid: presenting procedural scenery as literal verified property imagery
high instance counts on constrained devices

templates.label: Cinematic Gaming Commerce
templates.summary: Entertainment storefront architecture with cinematic entry, custom navigation, horizontal discovery and campaign-like merchandising.
templates.mobile: Convert horizontal/hover-dependent discovery to swipe/stacked patterns and retain labelled navigation.
templates.reducedMotion: Remove glitch/parallax transitions while retaining category and commerce structure.
avoid: shipping legacy plugin dependencies without audit
using custom cursor as the only interaction cue
